# Sydney Housing Price Prediction and Decision Support System

Deakin ML Mini Project - regression modelling and a deployed decision support
tool for property prices in Mosman, Parramatta and Campbelltown, Sydney.

## What's here

- `housing_analysis.ipynb` - the main notebook 
- `raw_property_data.csv`, `cleaned_property_data.csv` - the data
- `app_filled.png`, `app_result.png` - screenshots 
- `Sydney_housing_app/` - the deployed Streamlit app, see its README to run it
